caption:
Mor Kuzhambu 
spiced coconut buttermilk curry 

Nutrition: 
C: 26 | F: 13 | P: 8
Calories: 257 per serve 
Serves 3

Ingredients 
coconut paste: 
1 tbsp tuvar dal
1 tsp rice 
1 tsp coriander seeds
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
3 green chillies
1 inch ginger
6 curry leaves
1/4 cup coconut

1 cup curd
1 cup water

200 grams yellow pumpkin
1 cup water + 1/4 tsp haldi

1 tbsp sesame oil
1/2 tsp rai
1/4 tsp methi seeds
1-2 dry red chillies
pinch of hing
one sprig curry leaves

Method 
rince the toor dal + rice + coriander seeds +cumin seeds then soak in 1/4 cup hot water for 30 minutes
blend with the ginger + chilli + curry leaves + coconut and make a smooth paste
add that paste to the dahi + water and mix together so you have no lumps 

in a pot, add in the pumpkin along with water and haldi and bring to a boil, you want the pumpkin to cook but still have a slight bite as it will cook further

turn off the heat and add in the dahi coconut paste mix into this and stir 
you want to start the heat keeping it on low and let it come to a simmer 
tip: if you are making this for the first time and scared of curdling the dahi, add in a slurry of 1 tbsp rice flour + 2 tbsp water to the mix and combine, this will thicken and prevent any splitting of the curry 
add salt
once it begins to simmer, turn off the heat

in a small pan, make the tadka with the ingredients mentioned in the caption 
add to the curry and and cover for 5 minutes
stir together and your Mor Kozhambu is ready to enjoy
